latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Online Text To Video.

- Converts text scripts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, plain text up to 200MB) into shareable 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPUs.
- Fast processing: returns videos in 1–2 minutes after submission.
- Supports file uploads, session management, balance checking, and status queries.
- Automatic anonymous token generation and session setup on first use.
- Handles common workflows: quick edits, batch uploads, and iterative video refinement.
- Comprehensive error handling and clear guidance on best practices for optimal results.
